import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def helix_repeats(path, chain=None, rng=None, minlen=5):
    res,order=parse_pdb(path,chain=chain)
    o=[r for r in order if (rng is None or rng[0]<=r[1]<=rng[1]) and 'CA' in res[r]['atoms']]
    ss=dssp_like(res,o); nums=np.array([r[1] for r in o])
    CA=np.array([res[r]['atoms']['CA'] for r in o])
    segs=ss_segments(ss,nums,minlen=minlen)            # (start,end,len,i,j)
    return CA,nums,segs

def solenoid_params(CA,segs):
    """Repeat unit = consecutive helix pair. Period = spacing between helix i and i+2 starts.
    Twist/rise from the screw decomposition of unit k -> unit k+1."""
    st=[s[3] for s in segs]                             # index of each helix start
    periods=[st[i+2]-st[i] for i in range(len(st)-2)]
    p=int(np.median(periods))
    angs,rises,rms=[],[],[]
    for i in range(len(st)-2):
        a,b=st[i],st[i+2]; L=min(p, len(CA)-b)
        if L<20: continue
        P,Q=CA[a:a+L],CA[b:b+L]
        rms.append(rmsd_after(P,Q))
        Pc,Qc=P-P.mean(0),Q-Q.mean(0)
        U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc)
        d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T
        angs.append(np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip((np.trace(R)-1)/2,-1,1))))
        ev,evec=np.linalg.eig(R); ax=np.real(evec[:,np.argmin(np.abs(ev-1))]); ax/=np.linalg.norm(ax)
        rises.append(abs(float(ax@(Q.mean(0)-R@P.mean(0)))))
    return p,len(st),float(np.median(angs)),float(np.median(rises)),float(np.median(rms)),periods
